biggest_catch: The referrer's $50 is split: $25 at account opening and the remaining $25 only if the friend hits all three benchmarks (e-statements, 10 point-of-sale transactions, $500 direct deposit) within 60 days.
catches: Referred member must present the referral card from the current member at account opening; referral must be disclosed at that time.

Referring member earns: $25 when the referred member opens an account + $25 if the referred member meets all three benchmarks (e-statements; 10 point-of-sale transactions within 60 days; $500+ direct deposit).
New member must open a new SRU FCU share draft checking account; duplicate accounts or re-opened accounts don't qualify; joint owners ineligible unless they open their own account.
Benchmarks must be met within 60 calendar days of account opening; account credits applied within 60 calendar days of completion.
Cap: referring members limited to $500 in account credit per calendar year across all referral programs.
Offer subject to change or end at any time without notice; applications through third-party channels ineligible.
Referred member must be approved for membership and be 18+ at application.
Qualified direct deposit = recurring payroll, Social Security, and/or pension; P2P and bank transfers excluded.

steps: Pick up SRU FCU referral cards and give one to your friend.
Friend presents the referral card when opening a new share draft checking account at SRU FCU.
You earn $25 in account credit when the account opens.
Friend meets all three benchmarks within 60 days (e-statements, 10 POS transactions, $500+ direct deposit) and you earn the remaining $25 - up to $500/year.
timing: Account credits applied within 60 calendar days of benchmark completion; benchmarks must be met within 60 days of account opening.
